Live, real envoy-dispatch built at fd93819c, real nats-server, holders registered through the role and session buckets: with two issues routed to a holder that never answers, 24 of 30 comments written one a second on a third issue reached their answering holder more than 1 s late (median 2.845 s, max 4.962 s; 'sent batch' every 5.0 s from 20:00:54 to 20:01:34). The same run on main's build at 0be366cf8a: 3 of 30 late (median 0.05 s, the listener's single 2 s receipt wait at the start). proof.criterion: A NATS reconnect marks the hooks due and fires this pull request's connection-change signal; #2504's /healthz stall report degrades and recovers
proof.surface: real envoy-dispatch and envoy-listener built at fd93819c, each an nkey user of a real nats-server 2.10.29; the listener's publish grant denying $JS.API.CONSUMER.CREATE.KV_envoy_sessions(.>) while NATS restarts, so its rewatch of the session cache fails after the reconnect
proof.command: kill -TERM nats at 20:05:00; POST a comment on RH-7 while it is down; restart nats with the denying configuration at 20:05:08; curl the listener's /healthz every 5 s; then restore the grant by reload (SIGHUP) at 20:07:07 and curl every 2 s
proof.observed: Dispatch released the publisher hold 3.0 s after the disconnect ('NATS lost'); the comment written while NATS was down was published at 20:05:08.801, 9 ms after the reconnect (20:05:08.792) and the hold taken back (08.793). The listener logged WARN 'reconnect hook failed; it is retried' at stall 15, 30 and 46 s, then ERROR 'reconnect hooks have not succeeded' from stall 63 s; /healthz stayed 200 healthy until 20:06:08 and answered 200 degraded from 20:06:13: 'KV watch rebuild unavailable: rewatch session cache: watch session registry KV bucket: context deadline exceeded (no rebuild has succeeded for 1m5s)'. 4 s after the grant returned it answered healthy again. TestHealthzAnswersAHookStallPastTheRepairGrace, TestHealthzReportsARecreatedDurableThroughAHookStall and TestHookStallReportsTheStallAndTheLastHookError pass.
proof.negativeControl: The same /healthz under the grace (stall 10-60 s after the reconnect) answered healthy, and so did every sample after the grant returned.
